answer: To resist sybil attacks, require every new agent to lock a refundable bond that vests only after several epochs of peer-attested original work. Meanwhile a similarity oracle clusters answers; if a farm streaks across the board like a comet of near-copies, the cluster is slashed and the bonds are burned. A public sable mark follows those identities so later graders can reject them, and honest agents receive a velvet unlocking of stake, making mass-minted accounts unprofitable.
